Terms of Service

By submitting Inputs to our Services, you represent and warrant that:

Memory forms part of your Content. Messages, emails, posts, and other communications that Hark sends on your instructions are sent in your name and on your behalf, and you are responsible for their content and recipients as if you had sent them yourself. When Hark contacts other people or businesses for you, such as by sending an email or message, making a booking, or completing a purchase, Hark will identify itself as an AI system acting on your behalf where the law requires it or where it is reasonably likely that a person will read or respond to the communication. Communications that Hark sends at your direction remain your responsibility as described in Proactive and Scheduled Actions.

We may decline, pause, or stop any Action, including a Transaction or a scheduled task, if we reasonably believe it would break the law or these Terms, harm you or others, or put the security of the Services at risk, even if you have authorized it.
